address: 3 Queens Wharf, Wellington Central, Wellington, 6011, New Zealand
bio: The wharf building, c. 1887, served as a wool shed and a fish market before it morphed into this renowned restaurant in 1992. The sun-drenched, lofty room offers picturesque harbourside views. The seafood-heavy menu is rooted in European traditions with subtle Asian twists. Exact items change with the season and the day’s catch. Oysters, natural or battered, make a great starter. Also try the market fish or seafood risotto, which feature the finest catch of the day.
